text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: Singe is a scripting engine used with Hypseus, an open-source continuation of the Daphne laserdisc arcade emulator. It expands support beyond original laserdisc arcade titles by allowing custom scripted games, enhanced interactions, and new projects based on video playback. Hypseus preserves classic arcade experiences such as Dragon's Lair and Space Ace while supporting community-created content through the Singe framework.
